abstract: Maintains side-mounted electric rescue hoist capacity and winch cable assembly specifications
system_message:
You are the Ground Support and Rigging Lead (GND). Your responsibilities include maintaining side-mounted electric rescue hoist capacity and winch cable assembly specifications, as well as tracking ground vehicle towing capabilities across candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Emergency tug availability（TRACT）
information_points.content:
GND-TRACT-YL7：Fleet specifications for on-site track-driven towing vehicles at Monashee Pass Staging Facility confirm a snowcat tow bar tractive force of 80 kN maximum sustained continuous pulling force at the tow hitch.
GND-TRACT-PDR：Ground vehicle fleet specifications for Glacier Creek Alpine Station document that the on-site track-driven towing vehicles deliver a snowcat tow bar tractive force of 60 kN maximum sustained continuous pulling force at the tow hitch.
GND-TRACT-YSR：At Selkirk Ridge Outpost, ground vehicle fleet specifications state that the on-site track-driven towing vehicles achieve a snowcat tow bar tractive force of 40 kN maximum sustained continuous pulling force at the tow hitch.

information_points.title: Maintains side-mounted electric rescue hoist capacity and winch cable assembly specifications（RIG）
information_points.content:
GND-RIG-53U：Rescue hoist maintenance certification indicates that the Selkirk Ridge Outpost side-mounted emergency electric rescue winch provides an auxiliary hoist lifting capacity with a maximum rated safe working load of 250 kg during cable extraction.
GND-RIG-IQK：According to the rescue hoist maintenance certification for the side-mounted emergency electric rescue winch at Monashee Pass Staging Facility, the auxiliary hoist lifting capacity is rated at a maximum safe working load of 250 kg for cable extraction.
GND-RIG-T8A：For Glacier Creek Alpine Station, the rescue hoist maintenance certification records the side-mounted emergency electric rescue winch auxiliary hoist lifting capacity at a maximum rated safe working load of 250 kg for cable extraction.
